name: Kojak
description: A bald, lollipop sucking police detective with a fiery righteous attitude battles crime in New York City.

videos.title: The Marcus-Nelson Murders
videos.overview: A homicide detective begins to suspect that the black teenager accused of murdering two white girls is being framed by his fellow detectives.

videos.title: The Belarus File
videos.overview: Lieutenant Theo Kojak teams up with Dana Sutton, a comely federal agent, to uncover a conspiracy reaching back to the Nazi occupation of the Soviet Union.

videos.title: The Price of Justice
videos.overview: Top New York cop Theo Kojak finds himself trapped in a tangled web of false trials, jealousies and murderous scheming as he investigates the death of two young boys. Their bodies are discovered in a Harlem river, the boys mother is the major suspect. But what appears to be an open shut case soon becomes something much more sinister.

videos.title: Ariana
videos.overview: One of Kojak's old enemies uses Ariana, a young Greek girl, as bait to trap the legendary New York detective. Meanwhile, Kojak finds himself a brash young associate...

videos.title: Fatal Flaw
videos.overview: While Investigating the murder of a writer responsible for a Mob exposé, Kojak discovers that the dead man's wife is an old flame.

videos.title: Flowers for Matty
videos.overview: A fellow cop and Kojak's close friend is shot to death. Theo immediately starts an investigation, but to his dismay the case is taken away from him by the Internal Affairs Bureau, as his killed friend is suspected of bribery. Regardless of that, Kojak's continuing his own private research, as he believes in the detective's innocence. Cast includes Glynnis O'Connor and Ed Lauter.

videos.title: It's Always Something
videos.overview: After discovering the connection between a corrupt city commissioner and Columbian killers, Kojak is framed for the murder of a call girl and is prosecuted by former place detective Crocker, now an assistant D.A.

videos.title: None So Blind
videos.overview: When an accountant is murdered, Kojak becomes suspicious of the activities of a wealthy department store own and his family.

videos.title: Siege of Terror
videos.overview: Kojak has two hours to free the hostages from three robbers in an Army surplus store.

videos.title: Web of Death
videos.overview: A fellow detective, Nick Ferro, kills his wife's lover and tries to cover it up.

videos.title: One for the Morgue
videos.overview: Kojak is suspicious of anonymous tips suggesting that an underworld boss is attempting assassination of his rival which would lead to a mafia war.

videos.title: Knockover
videos.overview: A murder victim's diamond ring compounds a homicide case with that of a big robbery.

videos.title: Girl in the River
videos.overview: Kojak suspects that the strangler of seven women has returned, when another girl dies in similar circumstances.

videos.title: Requiem for a Cop
videos.overview: Kojak races a 48-hour deadline to prevent the burial without honors of his old friend, an officer accused of corruption.

videos.title: The Corrupter
videos.overview: Kojak suspects that new store staff may be involved in murder of a jewelry store owner.

videos.title: Dark Sunday
videos.overview: The murder of a car thief reveals vital clues to a $500,000 heist.

videos.title: Conspiracy of Fear
videos.overview: Kojak tries to hold up an urban re-development project until he solves a murder case.

videos.title: Cop in a Cage
videos.overview: Freshly freed from prison, a criminal jailed by Kojak wants revenge and is targeting Kojak's niece on her wedding day.

videos.title: Marker to a Dead Bookie
videos.overview: Kojak pretends to be corrupted (buying even more expensive suits than usual and a brand new Cadillac)—not without opposition from Capt. McNeil, who tries save as much police money he can—to catch a narcotics dealer in the act.

videos.title: Last Rites for a Dead Priest
videos.overview: During a jeweler's convention, a jewel thief disguises as a priest in order to steal valuable gems.

videos.title: Death Is Not a Passing Grade
videos.overview: While teaching a criminal justice class at a local college, Kojak embarrasses a student with a criminal background, forcing him to leave a stolen item to have the upper hand in future classroom discussions.

videos.title: Die Before They Wake
videos.overview: A junkie prostitute holds the key which would help solving the murder cases of her roommate and a local TV reporter.

videos.title: Deliver Us Some Evil
videos.overview: A small time crook prepares to pull a big robbery to flee a pending murder charge.

videos.title: Eighteen Hours of Fear
videos.overview: A woman is coming back from winter holidays from Canada, smuggling two twenty Canadian dollar plates in her fake cast. Once she arrives in US she needs to run from the ex-partner in crime, who murdered her boyfriend and wants get the plates back.

videos.title: Before the Devil Knows
videos.overview: A man has embezzled a million dollars in US Government bonds, and David and Kevin burgle the bonds from the safe in his high rise apartment.

videos.title: Dead on His Feet
videos.overview: A detective is hiding his terminal illness, while pursuing his partner's murderer. As he knows that he won't make it he's even more motivated to find a murder even if he'll have to pay the highest price.

videos.title: Down a Long and Lonely River
videos.overview: A young psychologist asks Kojak for help after her fiancee attempts to settle an old score with the people who left him to take the whole responsibility for the crime which sent him to prison.

videos.title: Mojo
videos.overview: Kojak goes undercover as a chemist in order to expose the thieves who stole morphine from an insurance company, to sell it at an inflated price.

videos.title: Therapy in Dynamite
videos.overview: A psychopathic bomber targets people who hurt his friend. Kojak must find link between victims in order to find suspect.

videos.title: The Only Way Out
videos.overview: A 12-year-old boy wants Kojak's help in locating his missing father. Case takes an interesting twist in which Kojak is not led to the kid's missing father, but to a thief who fled to Brazil with stolen $25 million. With John Hillerman.

videos.title: The Chinatown Murders (1)
videos.overview: To head off a bloody war between rival crime families, Kojak must find out who committed a series of murders in Chinatown and bring them to justice.

videos.title: The Chinatown Murders (2)
videos.overview: To head off a bloody war between rival crime families, Kojak must find out who committed a series of murders in Chinatown and bring them to justice.

videos.title: Hush Now, Don't You Die
videos.overview: Kojak tracks down a college student that he suspects has been raped, but is too afraid to come forward after she witnesses one of the assailants murdered by the other.

videos.title: A Very Deadly Game
videos.overview: After a policeman is shot by a local known criminal, Kojak sets out to get the man behind bars, but his efforts are disrupted by FBI agents who are supposed to be helping.   He then pursues the trail alone, taking him to Califormia where the criminal is hiding out.

videos.title: Wall Street Gunslinger
videos.overview: Kojak goes undercover as a Greek millionaire to track down the person responsible for the theft of $20 million in securities as well as three murders.

videos.title: Slay Ride
videos.overview: When several men fall to their deaths at the same convention, Kojak doubts that mass suicide is the explanation.

videos.title: Nursemaid
videos.overview: Kojak and Crocker must protect a bookkeeper from madmen who will stop at nothing to keep her from testifying in court.

videos.title: You Can't Tell a Hurt Man How to Holler
videos.overview: Kojak suspects that a small-time criminal was framed for a murder, but the man refuses to cooperate when Kojak tries to prove his innocence.

videos.title: The Best Judge Money Can Buy
videos.overview: A judge (John Randolph) whose son was also a judge was murdered and his death was made to look like he had committed suicide. Now, his father must decide whether or not he should allow a murderer (Abe Vigoda) to walk, or risk letting information out that shows his son as a corrupt judge.

videos.title: A Souvenir from Atlantic City
videos.overview: Kojak's attempt to solve a terrorist bombing is frustrated by the fact that the only eyewitness is being held incommunicado by the police in another case.

videos.title: A Killing in the Second House
videos.overview: Kojak comes up against a former cop, now a private investigator, who tries to make his client's suicide look like murder so he can collect money from life insurance.

videos.title: The Best War in Town
videos.overview: A rookie cop (Mark Shea) stumbles upon an attempted murder of a rival gang leader in which he foils, triggering a gang war.

videos.title: Cross Your Heart and Hope to Die
videos.overview: A mentally depressed woman (Andrea Marcovicci) witnesses her date being murdered by her neighbor who has an interest in her.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: An informant (Paul Anka) uses a detective in order to further his way up the criminal ladder.

videos.title: Loser Takes All
videos.overview: A woman (Ja'net DuBois) intentionally plots to have her husband murdered during a diamond heist that she had planned with her secret love interest (Leslie Nielson).

videos.title: Close Cover Before Killing
videos.overview: Kojak investigates a homicide in which the murder was covered up by a torched building.

videos.title: Acts of Desperate Men
videos.overview: An accountant assists a sniper (Bruce Kirby Jr.) on a vendetta.

videos.title: Queen of the Gypsies
videos.overview: A young gypsy woman who witnesses a a bank robbery decides that looting banks is preferable to telling fortunes, so she recruits the thieves for a master plan to rob six banks in one day.

videos.title: Night of the Piraeus
videos.overview: The murder of a sailor newly arrived on a freighter from Greece and a strangely unconcerned witness lead Kojak to suspect that an object was smuggled into the country in the man's belt.

videos.title: Elegy in an Asphalt Graveyard
videos.overview: Kojak is particularly affected by the murder of a beautiful Manhattan playgirl.

videos.title: The Good Luck Bomber
videos.overview: Kojak and the bomb squad are stymied by a series of bombs that seemingly can't be defused.

videos.title: Unwanted Partners
videos.overview: Crocker fails to believe that his old childhood friend who is  the main focus of a police investigation, could be involved in illegal activity.

videos.title: Two-Four-Six for Two Hundred
videos.overview: While an accused thief sits in jail waiting for his lawyer to arrange bail, Kojak tries to decipher a phrase heard during an unsuccessful attempt to steal a paint company truck.

videos.title: The Trade-Off
videos.overview: Kojak arrests the ringleader (Mark Stevens) of a drug operation, whose gang kidnaps Captain McNeil's wife in order to trade her for the evidence they have against him.

videos.title: I Want to Report a Dream
videos.overview: A psychic (Ruth Gordon)informs police involving a dream in which she sees a murder take place before it ever happened.

videos.title: A Question of Answers (1)
videos.overview: An unjustly imprisoned man hopes to clear his name by helping Kojak trap the load shark who framed him.

videos.title: A Question of Answers (2)
videos.overview: To clear his name, a man helps Kojak take down a loan shark.

videos.title: My Brother, My Enemy
videos.overview: Kojak must overcome outside influences in order to protect a detective (Sylvester Stallone)who accidentally shot a boy.

videos.title: Sweeter Than Life
videos.overview: While responding to a homicide call, Kojak discovers his camera that had disappeared earlier at a party in which he, his nephew and friend attended.  His nephew's friend steals the camera and uses it to buy drugs from the murdered man.  They witness the murder and are reluctant to involve the police.  Kojak's nephew must go 'cold turkey' before he ends up like his friend who overdosed.

videos.title: Be Careful What You Pray For
videos.overview: Crocker lectures female students on rape at a local catholic school, while two Puerto Rican brothers kill a priest during a truck heist.

videos.title: Secret Snow, Deadly Snow
videos.overview: Kojak is determined to nail a big-time drug dealer who shot a plastic surgeon who was already dead from what they first believed to be natural causes.

videos.title: Life, Liberation, and the Pursuit of Death
videos.overview: A woman who witnesses a body being dumped into the harbor is so fragile minded that the man who dumped the body tries to use psychology against her in order to eliminate her from the picture.

videos.title: Out of the Frying Pan . . .
videos.overview: A veteran cop who is battling alcoholism and demotion after being held responsible for the shooting death of a friend impedes Kojak's murder investigation as he tries to clear his name and win back his shield.

videos.title: Over the Water
videos.overview: A mobster's son puts out a contract on Kojak's life after he breaks up a barroom brawl.

videos.title: The Nicest Guys on the Block
videos.overview: A colleague of Kojak's, Detective Weaver, discovers that a former high school buddy is now involved in fencing a million dollars' worth of stolen diamonds.

videos.title: No Immunity for Murder
videos.overview: Refusing to believe that a prostitute and her partner are responsible for a bookkeeper's murder, Kojak run afoul of the FBI when he tries to investigate further.

videos.title: A Long Way from Times Square
videos.overview: Kojak and Crocker head to Cory, Nevada to pick up a witness (Vincent Bagetta), but they encounter trouble in town.

videos.title: Money Back Guarantee
videos.overview: A murdered cop and a wealthy young woman put Kojak on the trail of a car-theft ring in which the victims appear to cooperate with the thieves.

videos.title: A House of Prayer, a Den of Thieves
videos.overview: An old colleague calls from Las Vegas to say he has captured a counterfeiter Kojak has been looking for, but the elderly man is murdered before Kojak can bring him back to New York.

videos.title: How Cruel the Frost, How Bright the Stars
videos.overview: (Christmas Episode) Stavros helps a woman (Betsy Slade) find her desperate boyfriend (Darrell Fetty), while Kojak tries to find out why a man (James Griffith) shot at a woman (Jesse Welles) in a local bar.

videos.title: The Forgotten Room
videos.overview: Kojak doubts a young man is guilty in the murder of a prostitute, even the circumstantial evidence points to him.

videos.title: On the Edge
videos.overview: Kojak is concerned that a fellow detective's obsessive work habits are endangering both his home life and his career.

videos.title: A Wind from Corsica
videos.overview: Kojak must prevent a man from killing the person who framed his recently deceased brother.

videos.title: Bad Dude
videos.overview: A private detective recently arrived from the West Coast puzzles Kojak when he appears to be deliberately making himself a killer's next target.

videos.title: A Grave Too Soon
videos.overview: Kojak puts the pressure on a known member of an organized crime syndicate when a dead undercover cop is found murdered.

videos.title: The Frame
videos.overview: Kojak finds himself under investigation by Internal Affairs when a thief he arrested without sufficient evidence claims he paid Kojak a bribe.

videos.title: Deadly Innocence
videos.overview: Kojak investigates the hit-and-run death of a police chemist and uncovers a frame-up.

videos.title: Justice Deferred
videos.overview: The discovery of a skeleton at a demolition site reopens an 18-year-old murder case.

videos.title: Both Sides of the Law
videos.overview: Kojak competes with a world-famous criminologist to recover five priceless Rembrandt drawings.

videos.title: Birthday Party
videos.overview: On her birthday, Kojak's niece is kidnapped by criminals who want to exchange her for an incarcerated cop killer.

videos.title: A Summer Madness
videos.overview: Already confronted with problems at home, Detective Jeff Braddock must face the inquiry of the murder of his mistress, while Kojak investigates the bombing of a restaurant.

videos.title: Law Dance
videos.overview: Kojak searches for the killer of a key witness in a prominent murder trial.

videos.title: Out of the Shadows
videos.overview: Kojak and the detectives scour the city for "The Grim Reaper", a slasher who murders his victims out of greed.

videos.title: A Need to Know
videos.overview: Kojak and the detectives try to stop a child molester, who has diplomatic immunity, before he strikes again.

videos.title: An Unfair Trade
videos.overview: The shooting of a Puerto Rican youth by the Police angers the community.

videos.title: A Hair-Trigger Away
videos.overview: The drug addicted girlfriend of a cop is under scrutiny for accidentally killing his partner during a drug bust.

videos.title: By Silence Betrayed
videos.overview: Kojak finds that the longshoreman's lips are sealed when he inquires into labor-related waterfront murders.

videos.title: A Shield for Murder (1)
videos.overview: A wealthy political leader quashes Kojak's efforts to reopen a two-year-old matricide case.

videos.title: A Shield for Murder (2)
videos.overview: When Kojak gets too close to discovering the truth, he is framed.

videos.title: The Pride and the Princess
videos.overview: An émigré princess and her servant scheme to recover family jewels they believe are held by a mobster.

videos.title: Black Thorn
videos.overview: Private eye Salathiel Harms returns, pursuing the same bail jumper as Kojak.

videos.title: Where Do You Go When You Have No Place To Go?
videos.overview: A desperate unemployed ironworker accidentally kills a construction kingpin.

videos.title: Dead Again
videos.overview: A woman informs the detectives that she had seen a wanted man that had supposedly died in a house fire, but they don't believe her until it's too late.

videos.title: The Godson
videos.overview: Kojak's godson becomes mixed up with a gang involved in an armed robbery.  Can Kojak get through to his godson before it's too late?

videos.title: The Condemned
videos.overview: A boxer accused of murder holes up inside a church and threatens to kill the parishioners unless the police meet his demands.

videos.title: When You Hear the Beep, Drop Dead
videos.overview: A wealthy ecologist's wife plans to murder him and use a fake phone message to frame a nonexistent call girl.

videos.title: I Was Happy Where I Was
videos.overview: A Puerto Rican cop goes undercover in his old neighborhood to find out who is trying to start a barrio gang war.

videos.title: Kojak's Days (1)
videos.overview: Kojak must unravel the mystery of a white Roll-Royce with a body in the trunk while trying to find a woman who murdered her husband.

videos.title: Kojak's Days (2)
videos.overview: The search continues for a woman who murdered her husband, abandoned her child and is threatening to commit suicide.

videos.title: Monkey on a String
videos.overview: A member of the police force falls prey to a powerful crime figure. With Albert Paulsen and Judith Light.

videos.title: Kiss it All Goodbye
videos.overview: Crocker accidentally shoots a fashion model while trying to stop a robbery, jeopardizing his career.

videos.title: Lady in the Squad Room
videos.overview: Kojak and a female detective must overcome their dislike for each other when she is transferred from the rape squad to help nab a drug-dealing rapist-muderer.

videos.title: Sister Maria
videos.overview: A vengeful nun tries to bring to justice the gangster who ordered the murder of her sister. (60 mins)

videos.title: The Queen of Hearts Is Wild
videos.overview: The girlfriend of a local gangster who hates Kojak is the only witness in the murder of a police officer.

videos.title: A Strange Kind of Love
videos.overview: A psychotic murderer thinks that a television talk show host is subliminally brainwashing him to murder.

videos.title: Laid Off
videos.overview: A laid off police officer with two jobs and a sick wife takes a bribe under pressure from a loan shark.

videos.title: Cry for the Kids
videos.overview: A teenager accidentally kills a gangster's hired hand while robbing him, only to have a rival gangster hire him to take out the competition in order to control the neighborhood in which he doesn't own.

videos.title: Once More from Birdland
videos.overview: A singer(Andrea Marcovicci) is determined to prove her wrongfully imprisoned father innocent after he spends 14 years in prison.

videos.title: Caper on a Quiet Street
videos.overview: A woman is Kojak's only link to finding $6 million dollars, but her boyfriend (Armand Assante) has other plans.

videos.title: Letters of Death
videos.overview: Anonymous messages begin turning up informing a model that someone close to her is in danger of being murdered.

videos.title: Tears for All Who Loved Her
videos.overview: Crocker (played by Kevin Dobson) falls for a woman (played by Jennifer Warren) while investigating the death of her mobster husband.

videos.title: The Summer of '69 (1)
videos.overview: Kojak must reopen a case in which the prime suspect of three women was shot and killed after a shootout with him.  Now, eight years later, the murders have started again and it appears that Kojak may've killed the wrong man.

videos.title: The Summer of '69 (2)
videos.overview: After Kojak is placed on suspension, he continues to review the 8-year old case while a serial killer (Stephen McHattie) strikes again.

videos.title: Case Without a File
videos.overview: Kojak poses as a murdered private investigator in order to find out why he was murdered.

videos.title: I Could Kill My Wife's Lawyer
videos.overview: A detective (Joey Aresco) believes that his wife's divorce lawyer (David Ladd) hired an arsonist to destroy his boat.

videos.title: Justice for All
videos.overview: While Kojak is contemplating leaving the police department to become a law firm's investigator, a series of recent drug related deaths begin to overshadow his decision.

videos.title: Mouse
videos.overview: Kojak encounters a case where a highly respected surgeon may be doing unnecessary surgeries in order to use the money to pay off gambling debts.

videos.title: Chain of Custody
videos.overview: Kojak is suspended after reacting to an incompetent district attorney who failed to convict a known killer.

videos.title: The Captain's Brother's Wife
videos.overview: Kojak tries to protect Captain McNeil's widowed sister-in-law from big time gamblers.

videos.title: No License to Kill
videos.overview: Kojak offers to help a jealous police officer search for a professional hit man.

videos.title: The Halls of Terror
videos.overview: Kojak and the detectives go undercover in a local hospital in order to investigate a string of murders that have been occurring while the victims were on duty.

videos.title: May the Horse Be with You
videos.overview: A retired police officer is injured after attempting to prevent the theft of a race horse that he illegally housed in the NYPD stables.

videos.title: Photos Must Credit Joe Paxton
videos.overview: A photographer (played by Tige Andrews) becomes the prime suspect in a jewel theft and phony kidnapping of a former actress (played by Antoinette Bower) in which he photographs.

videos.title: 60 Miles to Hell
videos.overview: Crocker is taken hostage while trying to transport a prisoner back to New York.

videos.title: In Full Command
videos.overview: After being rejected for a promotion, a disgruntled inspector sees a current case as a way to boost his career.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 12 wins & 22 nominations total
